"""Bounded quantified projection and grounding of protocol predicates.

Protocol predicate JSON is projected onto NetNomos AST formulas:

* ``cmp`` becomes one :class:`Compare` over projected terms;
* ``any``/``all`` over a field family becomes a bounded quantifier projection.
  For order comparisons the quantifier is collapsed onto ``min``/``max`` of the
  K cells (which is exact for a finite window), and for eq/ne onto an explicit
  disjunction/conjunction of the K grounded comparisons.

Predicate IDs are the zero-based input positions and stay distinct even when
two predicates project onto equivalent formulas.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence

from netnomos.ast import (
    BinaryTerm,
    BoolAnd,
    BoolOr,
    Compare,
    Constant,
    Formula,
    FuncCall,
    SymbolRef,
    Term,
    formula_to_string,
)
from netnomos.specs import COMPARATOR_BY_OP, Comparator, ConstantSelectorSpec, QuantifierTemplateSpec


@dataclass(slots=True)
class GroundedPredicate:
    predicate_id: int
    formula: Formula
    display: str
    position: int
    source: dict[str, Any]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SelectedConstant:
    value: int
    label: str | None


def project_term(
    term: Mapping[str, Any], cell_of: Any, cell_name: Any
) -> tuple[Term, str]:
    """Project one protocol term onto an AST term plus its display string."""
    if "const" in term:
        value = int(term["const"])
        return Constant(value), str(value)
    if "sum" in term:
        parts = []
        displays = []
        for ref in term["sum"]:
            name = cell_name(cell_of(ref))
            parts.append(SymbolRef(name))
            displays.append(name)
        return FuncCall("sum", tuple(parts)), "SUM(" + ", ".join(displays) + ")"
    if "scale" in term:
        scale = int(term["scale"])
        name = cell_name(cell_of(term["ref"]))
        return BinaryTerm("*", Constant(scale), SymbolRef(name)), f"({scale} * {name})"
    name = cell_name(cell_of(term["ref"]))
    return SymbolRef(name), name


def project_quantified_family(
    family_name: str,
    family_fields: Sequence[str],
    template: QuantifierTemplateSpec,
    op: Comparator,
    constant: SelectedConstant,
) -> tuple[Formula, str]:
    """Project ``any``/``all`` over the K slots of one field family."""
    terms = tuple(SymbolRef(name) for name in family_fields)
    constant_term = Constant(int(constant.value))
    display = (
        f"{template.quantifier.upper()} k IN {{{', '.join(str(i) for i in range(len(family_fields)))}}}: "
        f"{family_name}[k] {op.value} {constant.value}"
    )
    if op in {Comparator.GT, Comparator.GE}:
        aggregate = "min" if template.quantifier == "forall" else "max"
        return Compare(op.value, FuncCall(aggregate, terms), constant_term), display
    if op in {Comparator.LT, Comparator.LE}:
        aggregate = "max" if template.quantifier == "forall" else "min"
        return Compare(op.value, FuncCall(aggregate, terms), constant_term), display
    grounded = tuple(Compare(op.value, SymbolRef(field), constant_term) for field in family_fields)
    if template.quantifier == "forall":
        return BoolAnd(grounded), display
    return BoolOr(grounded), display


def project_predicate(
    predicate: Mapping[str, Any], cell_of: Any, cell_name: Any, family_cells: Any
) -> tuple[Formula, str]:
    """Project one protocol predicate onto an AST formula and its display string."""
    op = COMPARATOR_BY_OP[predicate["op"]]
    kind = predicate["kind"]
    if kind == "cmp":
        left, left_display = project_term(predicate["left"], cell_of, cell_name)
        right, right_display = project_term(predicate["right"], cell_of, cell_name)
        formula = Compare(op.value, left, right)
        return formula, f"{left_display} {op.value} {right_display}"
    if kind not in {"any", "all"}:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported predicate kind: {kind}")
    field_name = str(predicate["field"])
    family = [cell_name(cell) for cell in family_cells(field_name)]
    template = QuantifierTemplateSpec(
        name="window",
        quantifier="exists" if kind == "any" else "forall",
        operators=[op],
        constant=ConstantSelectorSpec(mode="explicit", values=[int(predicate["value"])]),
    )
    return project_quantified_family(
        field_name, family, template, op, SelectedConstant(int(predicate["value"]), None)
    )


def ground_predicates(
    predicates: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], cell_of: Any, cell_name: Any, family_cells: Any
) -> list[GroundedPredicate]:
    """Ground every protocol predicate, keeping input positions as IDs."""
    grounded: list[GroundedPredicate] = []
    for position, predicate in enumerate(predicates):
        formula, display = project_predicate(predicate, cell_of, cell_name, family_cells)
        grounded.append(
            GroundedPredicate(
                predicate_id=position,
                formula=formula,
                display=display,
                position=position,
                source={"predicate": dict(predicate)},
            )
        )
    return grounded


def clause_display(grounded: Sequence[GroundedPredicate], clause: Sequence[int]) -> str:
    """Human readable disjunction of one clause, in clause order."""
    return " OR ".join(f"({formula_to_string(grounded[pid].formula)})" for pid in clause)
